Definition: from G473 and the middle voice of G5021; to range oneself against, i.e. oppose:--oppose themselves, resist.
BiblicalUsage: To range oneself against, to oppose, to resist. Peter says God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble, and James says the same. The word is the stance of opposition, and Scripture turns it both ways: God resists the proud, and the proud resist God.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for opposing carries no doctrine of its own; its warning is the apostles', that God Himself resists the proud, and the humble are the ones He lifts.
RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; James, Brother of Jesus; Paul
